answer: The orchard graph is validated at intake and the river frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and falcon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 13 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 2213 account sybil into a 11 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
